name: PCK-DataCross Jastrebarsko
notes: Operator pages place the Jastrebarsko data center in the Jalsevac industrial zone, 35 km from Zagreb, with 1,300 m2 total area for IT equipment, carrier-neutral connectivity, Tier 3 / 99.982% SLA positioning, redundant 4 MW transformer plants, and 4 x 1.6 MW diesel generators. PCK material says the facility was opened on 2012-11-22; project-level IT load was not disclosed.

name: PCK-DataCross Kriz
notes: PCK's own site lists a second Kriz data center with construction in planning, up to 1,600 m2 IT space, 99.995% / Tier 4 SLA target, two Zagreb optical nodes, CIX/VIX connectivity, and a location 50 km from Zagreb in a different seismic area. DatacenterMap lists the Kriz industrial-zone site and notes presale/rental of server-room floors; no official MW value was found.

name: Pantheon AI Topusko hyperscale AI data center campus
notes: Pantheon Atlas announced a Topusko campus with 1 GW total capacity and 800 MW usable IT load on a 310-acre site, expandable to 450 acres, with construction planned for early 2027 and full operations targeted for Q1 2029. A 2026-07-23 company release says Croatia's transmission operator HOPS approved the power-supply blueprint; Sisak-Moslavina County formally recognized the project as regionally important.

name: DC North Varazdin
developer: DC North d.o.o. / Ilkari; originally CRATIS and Muraplast
notes: Ilkari's current Croatia data centre page identifies DC North in Varazdin as an Uptime Tier III-certified, carrier-neutral facility with 2,000 m2 net technical space, 4 MW power capacity, and expansion potential to 10 MW. The July 2026 spec sheet gives 2.8 MW installed power capacity supplied via a 4 MW ring. CRATIS says DC North was ceremoniously opened on 2023-11-24.

name: HR-ZOO RI Rijeka data center
developer: SRCE / HR-ZOO; University of Rijeka site
notes: SRCE's HR-ZOO project description says five data centers were constructed or adapted and equipped in Osijek, Rijeka, Split, and Zagreb. The HR-ZOO publication identifies the renovated HR-ZOO RI data center at the University campus Trsat in Rijeka. MEP project details list HR-ZOO Rijeka gross area of 213 m2 and designed DC power of 125 kW; DatacenterMap gives the address as Radmile Matejcic 2, Rijeka.
